{{Top|leg}}
'''Recording crystals''' were a type of recording and communication device invented by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bilpin]] around [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. [[Myri Antilles]] was the first agent to [[Mission to the Galactic Princess|use them in the field]] and discovered that they were not as secure as Bilpin thought, as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Oobolo]] was able to jam the crystals both ways, forcing her father, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to rescue her.
